subject: Quote needed for Cluj-Constanta route
body: Hello, could you send us a price quote for road transport from Cluj to Constanta? We'd need it for a shipment planned this week.
note: Concrete quote request with a route and timeframe.

subject: Pricing question
body: Hi, what's your general rate for road freight? Just comparing a few providers right now.
note: Same category as #1, but vague and low-commitment - tests that urgency is judged from content, not just category.

subject: 5 pallets ready for pickup TODAY
body: The 5 pallets for order #4410 are packed and ready. Truck needs to be here before 3pm today, otherwise we lose the loading slot.

subject: Cargo ready for pickup tomorrow morning
body: Just a heads up, tomorrow morning we'll have cargo ready for pickup at dock 3. No rush, just confirm a driver whenever convenient.
note: Needs action today (confirm driver) but not an emergency.

subject: Driver waiting at gate, no loading instructions
body: Our driver has been at your gate for 40 minutes and has no loading instructions. Please advise immediately or we'll have to leave.

subject: Please send invoice + waybill for yesterday's transport
body: Could you send us the invoice and the waybill (CMR) for yesterday's shipment? We need it for our own accounting today.

subject: Delivery confirmations from last month
body: Whenever you get a chance, could you send over the delivery confirmations from last month? Nothing urgent, just for our records.
note: Same category as #6, explicitly low urgency.

subject: URGENT - customs needs the CMR to release the shipment
body: Customs is holding the shipment at the border and needs the CMR document right now to release it. Every hour of delay costs storage fees.
note: Same category as #6/#7, but time-critical - tests urgency judgment within one category across the full range.

subject: Where is my shipment? Client is waiting at the dock
body: Our client has been waiting at the dock for over an hour. Can you tell us exactly where the truck is right now?
note: Active complaint-adjacent status request, real-time pressure.

subject: Any update on order #4521?
body: Just checking in - any update on the estimated delivery time for order #4521? No rush, just want to plan our week.
note: Routine status check, no real pressure despite being a question.

subject: Goods arrived damaged
body: We just opened the shipment and several boxes are visibly damaged - looks like water damage. We need this resolved urgently, the client is furious.
note: Textbook urgent complaint, should escalate straight to Manager.

subject: Missing items in delivery
body: We counted the delivery and 3 items are missing from what was on the invoice. Please look into this as soon as possible.
note: Second complaint example, different wording, still urgent.

subject: New fuel surcharge rates for next quarter
body: Dear partner, please find attached our updated fuel surcharge table effective next quarter. No action needed on your part.
note: Informational, not from a client, no action needed - fallback to Manager, low urgency.

subject: Question about your services
body: Hello, I saw your company online. Do you also handle international shipments, or only domestic?
note: General inquiry, doesn't map cleanly to any operational category.

subject: Can you also give me a price while you're at it?
body: Following up on our shipment from Tuesday (order #4398) - also, could you give me a rough price for a similar route next month?
note: Mixed intent (status + quote) - tests whether the model picks the dominant/actionable request.

subject: GPS shows truck stopped for 2 hours, is everything ok?
body: We noticed the truck for order #4521 has been stationary for 2 hours according to GPS. Can you check if everything is fine with the driver?
note: Operational alert dressed as a status question - should read as urgent.

subject: Small correction to yesterday's loading order
body: Small note: yesterday's loading order should have said 4 pallets, not 5. No need to act on this, just correcting the record.
note: Same category as urgent loading examples, but explicitly no action needed - tests that category != automatic urgency.

subject: Not happy with how the last shipment was handled
body: Overall we were not happy with how the last shipment was handled - communication was slow. We'd like to discuss this when convenient, no immediate crisis.
note: Complaint but explicitly not an emergency - tests that even 'Complaint' category isn't automatically 'urgent'.
